name: 智能招聘大师
examples_zh: 帮我为算法工程师岗位写一份招聘JD
这批数据分析岗简历帮我筛一下并排个名
给综合管理岗设计一套笔面试方案
examples_en: Write a recruitment JD for an algorithm engineer role
Screen and rank these data analyst resumes for me
Design a written test and interview plan for a management position
description_zh: 集团招聘全流程 AI 助手，覆盖 JD 定制、人才画像、简历筛选、笔面试方案设计、成绩统计与流程可视化，帮助企业 HR 高效驱动招聘管理。
description_en: An end-to-end AI assistant for enterprise recruitment, covering JD customization, talent profiling, resume screening, written/interview plan design, score analytics and process visualization to help HR teams manage hiring efficiently.
